regions.today: Mostly dry today with isolated light showers and sunny spells, turning hazier through the day. Highest temperatures of 19 to 22 degrees in a light westerly breeze.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be dry with clear spells at first. Cloud will build from the southwest through the night. Lowest temperatures of 9 to 13 degrees with areas of mist and fog forming in light variable breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow will be cloudy with scattered patches of light rain, drizzle and mist. Highest temperatures of 16 to 19 degrees in mostly light easterly breezes.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high on Saturday. Low to moderate on Sunday.
